item.title: Outlook: Improved PDF Preview on iOS
item.description: MIP-label protected PDFs are now supported in the PDF previewer along with a built-in control's toolbar for easier navigation. (GA: July CY2026) — Outlook

item.title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention-Endpoint DLP support classification of Azure RMS protected Office documents
item.description: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention (DLP) will now classify Azure RMS protected Office documents on Windows devices, enhancing data protection. This affects IT administrators managing DLP policies. (GA: June CY2026) — Microsoft Purview

item.title: Outlook: Variable number of message preview lines
item.description: Outlook for Windows and Outlook for Web will now allow users to modify how the preview text for emails show in the message list. The preview text can now take up 2 lines, 1 whole line, or 0 additional lines. (GA: July CY2026) — Outlook

item.title: Microsoft 365: Change Meeting Organizer via PowerShell Cmdlet in Exchange Online
item.description: Exchange Online allows admins to change the organizer of meetings via PowerShell. This change impacts administrators managing meeting logistics. (GA: June CY2026) — Microsoft 365

item.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Attach and reference an image when creating a presentation with Copilot in PowerPoint using Agent Mode.
item.description: PowerPoint now allows users to attach and reference images when creating presentations with Copilot in Agent Mode. This change affects users creating presentations. (GA: July CY2026) — PowerPoint, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Improved request flows for apps and agents blocked by admins
item.description: We are improving how users request access to apps and agents blocked by admins in Teams by introducing a clear, guided, and end-to-end request experience. This work reduces end-user friction by driving clarity into the request process and notifying users when there's been an update to their request. (GA: July CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Recently used emojis sync across devices
item.description: Microsoft Teams will sync recently used emojis and reactions across desktop and mobile devices, improving user expression. This change affects all Teams users. (GA: July CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Microsoft Teams: Secure Reliable Transport (SRT) Support for Teams town halls
item.description: Microsoft Teams will support Secure Reliable Transport (SRT) for streaming in town halls, improving video quality over the internet. This change affects users participating in Teams town halls. (GA: June CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Scoped Search for SharePoint app in Teams (Viva Connections)
item.description: With this feature, users accessing search through the Teams search icon while within the SharePoint app in Teams (Viva Connections) will be able to receive search result scoped to SharePoint global search. Hitting enter on the search query will then open the SharePoint search page. (GA: June CY2026) — Microsoft Teams, SharePoint

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Front-of-Room view control for Webinars & Structured Meetings in Teams Rooms on Android
item.description: Teams Rooms on Android will allow presenters to control the front-of-room display during webinars, enhancing presentation management. This change affects presenters in Teams meetings. (GA: June CY2026) — Microsoft Teams
